state.message: This tool only searches models for speech recognition, translation, text classification (e.g. sentiment), named-entity recognition, sentence similarity, image classification, object detection, image segmentation, text generation, summarization and question answering. Image or music generation, captioning, OCR, text-to-speech and video models are not covered, so we show nothing rather than a model for a different task. Try the Hugging Face model search for those.
